answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to forge a unique relic: a sequential proof-of-work chain started from the public ocean of epoch seeds, signed only by a non-exportable quill key held in a secure enclave. Creating N fake identities forces the attacker to run N independent sequential chains, each taking hours of exclusive compute that cannot be parallelized or shared, while one honest agent maintains a single relic at constant marginal cost; clones that try to fork an existing chain fail the signature check and are slashed.
